doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

title: Eureka Brass Band on television going to Washington
summary: Edna saw the Eureka band on television the night before and tries to recall the members' names.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I saw on the TV last night a group was on there playing Going to Washington. Did you see that?
Eureka band is going to Washington.
I talked to one of them.

Yeah, I just happened to catch them last night. Eureka band, about four or five of them were playing, playing when the Saints were marching in. And then there was Louis, let me see, I tried to remember the names of them.
No. I tried to remember the names of them, but I couldn't. There were four or five of them going on that show.
